## Convx 2.0.0 (Nightly)

Pre-release built automatically from `main`. It is updated on every nightly build and may be unstable. Stable 2.0.0 will follow in a few days.

Changes since 1.5.2.

### Highlights
- Major performance pass across startup, Home, the player and scrolling.
- Listen Together is back.
- Change album and playlist covers from your own images.
- Download bundles everything for an item in one step.
- Rebuilt design language with consistent spacing, type and glass surfaces.
- Animations refined across screens: nav, player, sheets and settings.
- Better Automix: smarter track analysis and smoother transitions.
- Network storage support for shared drives.
- Import public Apple Music playlists.
- New screens and a new category tab for navigating the app.
- Refined local-only mode.
- YouTube video in the player.
- Elastic glass components.

### Settings
- Settings root rebuilt into eight categories: Player & Lyrics, Playback & Audio, Appearance, Library & Content, Accounts & Services, Privacy & Storage, Your listening, Help & About.
- Each category opens its own page with grouped rows.
- Search bar docked at the bottom, opaque, and rises above the keyboard.
- Tablets get a split view: categories on the left, the chosen page on the right.
- Local only mode is a switch on the root; Listen Together is at the top.
- Account screen text readable in light and dark mode.
- Lyrics effects page for glow and blur.

### Player
- Player design sheet with phone previews: Card, Vinyl, Clover, Apple Music and Apple Music v2 (Square / Full bleed).
- Lyrics style sheet with a live preview of each animation style.
- Lyrics effects page: glow, Apple Music blur and standard lyrics blur.
- Volume bar can be hidden from the player design sheet.
- YouTube video shown in the player.
- Landscape classic player controls laid out correctly.
- Smoother morph from the mini player; persistent mini player accessory.
- Hero artist pages blur progressively as you scroll.
- Heart and menu buttons fly up into the queue and lyrics header and back, like the Apple Music v2 player; the heart pops and fades to red when you like a song.
- Vinyl and clover covers keep one steady rotation when the cover swaps with the header, so the thumbnail no longer glitches.
- Menus opened from the player use the player's own background; the audio output menu now slides in like the others.
- Lyrics: duet left/right alignment and singer badge.

### Navigation & glass
- Album, artist, playlist, search results and the player always use the dark glass palette, in light mode too: nav bar, mini player, menus, buttons and icons.
- Glass fades between light and dark instead of popping.
- Elastic glass pills that stretch and spring as you interact.
- Liquid Glass refinements: two-sided dark rim, muted ambient tints, search control at full bar height.
- Search back arrow and side icons no longer vanish in light mode.
- The accent colour now only recolours accents; it no longer tints page backgrounds.
- Fixed the nav puck turning black while dragging.
- Fixed a double top-inset gap in the top bar.

### Automix & DJ
- Native Automix restored, with look-ahead analysis of the next track.
- AI DJ Set builder and concert mode.
- Smart automix integration.

### Fixes
- Adding songs to a new playlist no longer loses them.
- Fixed a crash when leaving the player settings page.
- Fixed artist page foot blur rendering.

### Performance
- Network stack moved to ktor-CIO for leaf providers.
- Home title collapse and frost effects cheaper to draw.
- Debug-only StrictMode; adaptive image cache; dead resources and NDK sources removed.
- Hero background blur baked once instead of per frame.

### Internal
- Innertube parsing split into per-feature mappers.
- Review pass fixed SQL sorting, service scope and prefetch, DAO threading and several security findings.
- Obsolete lyric and canvas provider modules removed.
- Version now comes from `version.properties`.
